claims: AIPAC was established in 1954 by Isaiah L. Kenen.
AIPAC operates with over 5 million members.
AIPAC reports having over 5 million members/supporters across the U.S.
AIPAC supports political candidates via its PAC.
AIPAC PAC is a political action committee.
AIPAC PAC contributes to both Democratic and Republican candidates who support the U.S.-Israel alliance.
United Democracy Project (UDP) is an affiliated Super PAC.
American Israel Education Foundation (AIEF) is an affiliated 501(c)(3) organization.
AIEF funds educational trips to Israel for Congress members.
AIPAC was originally created to lobby for the Israeli government.
In 2005, a Pentagon analyst pleaded guilty to passing U.S. secrets to senior AIPAC officials.
United Democracy Project has spent millions in primary races.
